body:
<!-- plain-summary -->
Wyrd's S3 gateway can serve requests over the network, but it stores everything in a private, single-node database and local disk — it does not use the cluster's shared metadata store (TiKV), spread data across the fleet of storage servers, or participate in cluster coordination (etcd). So each gateway process is an isolated island: three gateways in a deployment are three separate object stores, not one. This wires the gateway to the cluster's real backends so it stores through them.

**Summary.** The `wyrd s3` gateway role hardcodes its backends instead of selecting them by config. `cmd_s3` (`crates/server/src/cli.rs:1220-1222`) constructs `RedbMetadataStore` + `FsChunkStore` + `MemCoordination` directly and never calls `resolve_backend` / `resolve_coordination_backend`. Every other cluster-facing role honors `--metadata-backend redb|tikv` (put/get/custodian, #255) and `--coordination-backend mem|etcd` (d-server, #449); the gateway was left out. Consequence: each gateway is a standalone single-node island — it does **not** talk to the D-servers, TiKV, or etcd. In the consolidated single-zone deploy stack (`deploy/small-multi-node/`, #256) the three gateways are three private redb stores, not a pool over shared cluster state. Found while consolidating that stack.

**Scope.**
- Gateway honors `--metadata-backend redb|tikv` (via `resolve_backend`) so it writes/reads object metadata to the same store the cluster uses.
- Gateway fans chunks to the D-servers over gRPC via `--endpoints` (reuse the `connect_fanout` path that backs `cluster_put`/`cluster_get`) instead of writing to a local `FsChunkStore`.
- Gateway honors `--coordination-backend mem|etcd` (via `resolve_coordination_backend`) so it participates in L5 coordination.

**Acceptance.**
- A gateway selects TiKV metadata + etcd coordination + gRPC D-server fanout purely by config.
- The three gateways in `deploy/small-multi-node/` read/write shared cluster state (one logical store), not three private redb files.

**Refs:** #256 (M4.5/consolidated single-zone deploy), #364 (S3 HTTP wire surface — done, protocol only), #255 (M4.4 backend selection — skipped the gateway), #449 (etcd coordination backend), #367 (first-deployment gate). Blocks the closed end-to-end write path (filed as a follow-on).

milestone.title: M4 — Production metadata backend
milestone.description: Step 2. Swap embedded redb for distributed TiKV behind the unchanged MetadataStore trait; multi-key atomic directory ops hold under the distributed store. Completes the single-zone data plane — a soft stopping point, not the release: the ★ Step-2 release point is M8 (proposal 0013 implementation arc, supersedes 0002). Plan: proposal 0015 (supersedes 0007; acceptance PR #417); tracker #201; first-deployment gate #367.

title: Gateway role composes over the cluster backends (not local redb/FS/Mem)
